storyTitle: Review Balance and Statement Credit Progress
oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews their 7,300 LBG coins and tracks progress toward their holiday spending money goal.
customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to inspect accumulated coins and cash-equivalent value.
storyTension: Ensuring the exact bill-reducing value of current points is clearly understood without promotional noise.
customerResolution: Clear display of points balance, cash-equivalent value, and current goal progress.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of reward balance and direct application toward bill-reducing statement credits.
